title: Woman with German Shepherd Dog in Backyard, 1950s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century black-and-white snapshot showing a smiling young woman kneeling on the lawn of a residential backyard beside her alert German Shepherd dog. She wears a collared knit top and mid-length skirt characteristic of early to mid-1950s casual fashion. The background displays lush hedges, a young tree casting long shadows, a rustic wooden outdoor work table, and single-story suburban houses. The print features decorative scalloped/deckled edges and a lab print number stamp on the reverse.
